product.title: ESPN Crisis Manager: The Salary Cap Leak
product.summary: Eight rounds of crisis management after undisclosed payments leak.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students act as an executive VP after a leak reveals payments made outside the stated cap. Each of eight rounds moves trust, legal exposure, revenue and control, and the story branches between defending transparency and defending legally, through fines, lost picks and sponsor reactions.
